# Mock API Server Project

This is a comprehensive mock API server built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Prisma.

## Features Implemented

✅ User registration and authentication with JWT
✅ Domain management with CRUD operations  
✅ Endpoint configuration with HTTP method support
✅ Response matching based on headers, cookies, query params, and body
✅ Database schema with Prisma and SQLite
✅ API routes for all functionality
✅ Mock API handler with dynamic routing
✅ Comprehensive documentation
✅ Home page and dashboard UI
✅ TypeScript implementation with Zod validation
